metadata.name: 心智娘 · 绯樱和风
metadata.tips: After some time with Wine Fox, she learned how to wear flowing kimono sleeves and why it helps to walk slowly. She says she is protecting the hem. Yet every crowded street ends with her holding your hand. The colony files this under lost-person prevention.
